portfolioName: TD Core Managed Portfolios - North American Equity
recommendationTitle: TD Core Managed Portfolios - North American Equity
recommendationSummary: A North American equity mandate seeking capital growth over a medium- to long-term investment horizon through Canadian and U.S. companies. The portfolio uses a core investment style and emphasizes established businesses with sound financial positions and defensible business models.
investmentApproach: The manager combines a top-down economic perspective with bottom-up fundamental analysis. Maximum U.S. exposure is 50% of portfolio market value, and the portfolio is not currency hedged.
